1 N. of Śiva or Rudra.
--2
N. of a mixed tribe, descendant
of a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra
mother (his business being to
catch or kill animals dwelling in
holes, such as snakes; cf.

.).

शोभांजनवृक्ष.

N. of a king of Mathurā and father
[]
of Kaṃsa. He was deposed by his
son; but Kṛṣṇa after having slain
